# scid

`scid.eco` from Scid's repository, [benini/scid](https://github.com/benini/scid), at commit
`fc26337165346192b5399780357561401930dff4` (2026-06-06; the file last changed 2011-02-12), unchanged.
Copyright (C) 1999-2003 Shane Hudson, distributed under the GNU General Public License: see `COPYING`, Scid's
own notice with the license text. The notice names no GPL version, so any version applies; it is used here
under GPL-3.0-or-later like the rest of this repository.

It adds positions to the opening list in `../chess-openings` (src/coach/openings.py): each is named after the
deepest position Lichess's list names along the line's own moves, Lichess's name wins where both name a
position, and a move into a position on either list is a Book move.
